text:
alex.m: bumping this thread — customer reported parser failures when streaming JSON mode with intermittent keepalive/empty-line frames. Happens for Python and TS clients, but more often when a Go ingest path parses the stream.

support-bot: created ticket INC-2345 and added priority P2 :white_check_mark:

joe.cust: getting this intermittently in prod, ~0.5% of streams fail with 'invalid character' and our app rejects the payloads.

maria.eng: can you paste the exact error and a small byte-level capture?

joe.cust: here's the log snippet —
```
2026-03-01T12:03:02Z ERROR parser: invalid character ' ' in numeric literal
2026-03-01T12:03:02Z DEBUG raw_chunk: "\n"
2026-03-01T12:03:02Z DEBUG raw_chunk: "{\"id\":1,\"result\":...}\n"
```

ben.sdk: fwiw our NDJSON streaming tests send an explicit `\n` keepalive between objects. We thought NDJSON allowed blank lines, but some Go decoders treat an empty token as an error depending on bufio.Read behavior.

clara.sre: repro steps from our side: we replayed a captured stream with Python client (requests stream) and TS client (fetch + ReadableStream). The Go service using encoding/json.Decoder.Decode fails ~1/200 runs when the client emits a zero-length chunk before a json object.

maria.eng: useful. Can you share minimal reproducer? even a curl / netcat paste.

ben.sdk: quick Python repro we used:
```python
import requests
s = requests.post(url, stream=True)
s.raw.write(b"\n")  # heartbeat
s.raw.write(b'{"event":"x"}\n')
# consumer uses a Go service that runs json.Decoder on the socket
```

alex.m: here's the Go error we saw: `json: invalid use of ,string struct tag, trying to unmarshal \"\" into int` in one trace but the more common is `invalid character ' ' looking for beginning of value`. Both suggest decoder state confusion when seeing an empty chunk.

clara.sre: mitigation ideas: 1) drop empty-line heartbeats on client side 2) switch to a length-prefixed framing 3) make Go side robust by skipping whitespace/empty tokens in read loop. We should pick a path that's low-risk for customers.

maria.eng: short-term ask: sdk team add a patch to ignore raw zero-length chunks and not emit them in ndjson mode by default. Also add an option to emit `--heartbeat--\n` literal instead of empty chunk so servers see something non-empty.

ben.sdk: ack. I'll prepare a patch for python and ts sdks that: 1) avoid writing zero-length frames; 2) if keepalive enabled, send `--heartbeat--\n` string. Will add unit tests asserting Go decoder compatibility.

joe.cust: appreciate the quick turnaround. We can toggle a feature flag to stop sending current heartbeats and validate.

maria.eng: long-term, engineering should add a note to JSON mode docs about framing expectations and mention NDJSON/empty-line caveats. Also add a regression test in our integration suite with a Go consumer.

alex.m: thanks all. assigning follow-ups: ben -> sdk patch PR, clara -> add integration test to streaming harness, maria -> docs blurb. Reopen if we see errors after patch. :pray:
